categories.main_business_segments: AIA Group Limited operates primarily in the life insurance sector across 18 Asian markets, offering individual life insurance, accident and health insurance, savings plans, employee benefits, credit life, and pension services. The Group's business segments are organized geographically into Mainland China, Hong Kong (including Macau), Thailand, Singapore (including Brunei), Malaysia, Other Markets (including Australia, Cambodia, India, Indonesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, and Vietnam), and Group Corporate Centre which handles corporate functions and shared services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AIA leverages advanced technology, digital platforms, and analytics extensively to enhance customer experience and distribution efficiency. The Group has achieved over 90% adoption of cloud technology, uses AI and generative AI solutions for underwriting, claims processing, customer service, and agent support. Their proprietary digital sales platform (iPoS) and customer super app (AIA+) facilitate seamless digital engagement. Amplify Health, an AI-powered health technology joint venture, provides health claims management and fraud detection solutions. The Group also integrates digital pre-authorisation and health provider management to improve healthcare delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AIA serves over 43 million individual policyholders and 16 million group insurance scheme members, focusing on middle-class and affluent individuals across Asia. Customers include individuals seeking life, health, savings, and retirement products, as well as corporate clients requiring employee benefits and pension services. The Group targets high-net-worth individuals with specialized wealth management offerings, particularly in Singapore and Hong Kong. Their distribution channels include a proprietary Premier Agency, bancassurance partnerships with major banks, and intermediated channels such as independent financial advisers and brokers.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIA operates in 18 Asian markets including Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan (China), Vietnam, Brunei, and holds a 49% joint venture in India. The Group has expanded its presence in Mainland China with new branches in Anhui, Shandong, Chongqing, and Zhejiang, accessing over 340 million target customers across 14 geographies. Other markets include a diverse range of countries in Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: AIA operates primarily in the downstream segment of the insurance supply chain, providing life and health insurance products and services directly to individual and corporate customers. The Group also engages in distribution through its proprietary agency network and partnerships with banks and financial intermediaries, facilitating product sales and customer engagement. Additionally, AIA invests in health technology and analytics to support insurance delivery and healthcare management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AIA's strategic focus centers on profitable growth through its Premier Agency and partnership distribution channels, digital transformation, and integrated healthcare solutions. The Group invests heavily in technology, digital platforms, AI, and analytics to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and distribution productivity. Their Integrated Healthcare Strategy aims to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective, supported by health technology innovations like Amplify Health. Sustainability and ESG commitments, including net-zero emissions by 2050, are integral to their strategy. The Group also emphasizes talent development and leadership through the AIA Leadership Centre and learning programs.
categories.revenue_model: AIA generates revenue primarily through the sale of life insurance, accident and health insurance, savings plans, and related financial products. Revenue streams include premiums from individual and group insurance policies, fees from investment and pension products, and income from health and wellness programs like AIA Vitality. The Group also earns investment income from its substantial asset portfolio. Distribution channels include direct sales via agency, bancassurance partnerships, and intermediated channels, with revenue recognized from new business premiums, renewal premiums, and single premiums.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIA is the largest independent publicly listed pan-Asian life insurance group and a market leader in Asia (excluding Japan) by life insurance premiums. It holds leading positions in most of its markets and is recognized globally for its professional agency network, ranking number one internationally for Million Dollar Round Table (MDRT) members for ten consecutive years. The Group competes with other major life insurers in Asia but differentiates itself through its scale, proprietary distribution, digital innovation, and integrated healthcare offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 31 December 2024, AIA reported total assets of US$305 billion and operating profit after tax (OPAT) of US$6.6 billion, a 12% increase per share from the prior year. The value of new business (VONB) reached a record US$4.7 billion, up 18% year-on-year. Embedded value equity increased by 9% per share to US$71.6 billion. The Group targets a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 9-11% in OPAT per share from 2023 to 2026. It returned US$6.5 billion to shareholders in 2024 through dividends and share buy-backs, reflecting strong cash generation and capital management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIA emphasizes delivering Healthier, Longer, Better Lives through high-quality, personalized insurance and wellness solutions. Its value proposition is built on a professional and digitally enabled Premier Agency, extensive bancassurance partnerships, and innovative integrated healthcare services. The Group differentiates itself with advanced technology adoption, including AI and generative AI, superior customer digital experience via AIA+, and a comprehensive wellness program, AIA Vitality. Its product ecosystem combines protection, savings, retirement, and health solutions tailored to evolving customer needs, supported by strong brand trust and market leadership.
